description: Silo stalk/stem conservation lens. Models conservation of deposit amount, BDV, stem, stalk, grown-stalk, roots, seeds, and reward-scaling across Beanstalk Silo transfer/reward/germination flows. Beanstalk-targeted but general for staking/reward-share protocols. NOT a 'find stalk words' scan: a function is sensitive only when a Silo-domain value AND an accounting/arithmetic/state-transition signal co-occur.
_fp_note: Two gates: a Silo-domain signal (a silo_domain_terms word in name/snippet/contract, OR the file sits under a silo_path_hints dir) AND an accounting signal (a category call/arithmetic pattern in the BODY). call_patterns are SPECIFIC function names (never bare SafeMath ops like .add(/.mul() which over-fire); discrimination comes from arithmetic_patterns + names. Generic ERC20 ops with no stalk/stem/deposit/bdv/roots context are dropped; comments stripped; bare `return s.x` getters (no arithmetic/call) are NOT tagged.

stalk_transfer.review_hint: Transferring stalk must preserve both user and global stalk/roots totals and cannot mint/burn via rounding.

deposit_transfer.review_hint: transferDeposit must preserve amount, BDV, stem, stalk and grown-stalk; the recipient stem must not be attacker-chosen.
examples: #364 TokenSilo._transferDeposit re-adds at a caller-supplied stem

deposit_batch_transfer.review_hint: Batch deposit transfer must conserve per-element amount/BDV/stem and the summed stalk across the batch.

stem_accounting.review_hint: Stem math must be consistent with deposit age; a wrong stem decouples grown-stalk from time.

stem_scale.review_hint: Stem<->stalk scale factor (1e6/PRECISION) must be applied; a missing factor zeroes or inflates rewards.
examples: #229 stalkReward divides by PRECISION; missing scale truncates to zero

stem_tip.review_hint: Stem tip drives grown-stalk; a stale or mis-scaled tip mis-prices every deposit.

grown_stalk.review_hint: Grown stalk = (stemTip - depositStem) * bdv / scale; verify scale, sign and that it is not double-counted.

earned_beans.review_hint: Earned beans derive from roots/stalk share; rounding or denominator errors over/under-claim.

bdv_to_stalk.review_hint: BDV->stalk conversion must use the correct per-BDV stalk and stem offset.

seeds_to_stalk.review_hint: Seeds/stalk-earned-per-season rate must be applied consistently per season.

roots_stalk_ratio.review_hint: roots/stalk ratio must stay consistent across mint/burn/transfer/reward; drift mis-allocates earned beans.

reward_scaling.review_hint: Reward scaling must use the correct denominator/scale; a missing 1e6 factor zeroes small rewards, a wrong sign overpays.

rounding_direction.review_hint: Rounding direction must favor the protocol; a roundUp on a value the user receives mints value across repeated calls.

round_up_down_mismatch.review_hint: Paired conversions (in/out) must round in opposite, protocol-safe directions; a matched roundUp/roundUp leaks value.
examples: deposit-in rounds down, withdraw-out rounds down

germinating_stalk.review_hint: Germinating stalk must convert to active stalk exactly once; double conversion or skip mis-states totals.

grown_stalk_recompute.review_hint: Mowing must add grown stalk once and advance lastStem; a missed update double-counts on the next mow.

deposit_stem_mismatch.review_hint: The stem used to re-add a deposit must be derived, not attacker-supplied; a chosen stem steals/forfeits grown stalk.
examples: #364 addDepositToAccount(recipient, token, stem, ...) with caller stem

zero_amount_deposit.review_hint: Zero-amount / dust deposits must be rejected or no-op; otherwise they can register empty deposits or shift accounting.

partial_deposit_transfer.review_hint: A partial deposit transfer must split BDV proportionally and keep the same stem; recomputing stem on a partial steals grown stalk.

user_vs_global_stalk.review_hint: Every user-stalk write must have a matching global-stalk write (and vice versa); a one-sided update breaks conservation.
examples: mint/burn/transfer updating user but not global stalk

user_vs_global_deposit.review_hint: Per-account deposit changes must reconcile with global totalDeposited/depositedBdv.

silo_reward_conservation.review_hint: Sum of distributed earned beans across users must equal beans minted to the Silo; scaling/denominator errors over/under-claim.

stale_stem_or_season.review_hint: Reward/grown-stalk math must use the current stem tip / season, not a stale snapshot.

cross_function_invariants.title: Stalk transfer preserves user and global stalk totals
cross_function_invariants.expected_property: sum of user stalk == global stalk before and after any transfer/mint/burn
cross_function_invariants.risk_if_broken: stalk minted or burned out of thin air; reward share skewed
cross_function_invariants.review_prompt: Trace every user-stalk write and confirm a matching global-stalk write conserves the total.

cross_function_invariants.title: transferStalk rounding cannot mint or burn value
cross_function_invariants.expected_property: roots transferred round in the protocol's favor; repeated transfers cannot net-mint roots/stalk
cross_function_invariants.review_prompt: Check the roots = (silo.roots-1)*stalk/silo.stalk + 1 rounding direction over repeated calls.

cross_function_invariants.title: transferDeposit preserves amount, BDV, stem, stalk and grown stalk
cross_function_invariants.expected_property: post-transfer (amount, bdv, stem, stalk, grownStalk) at recipient == pre-transfer at sender
cross_function_invariants.risk_if_broken: grown stalk inflated/forfeited; deposit value mis-stated
cross_function_invariants.review_prompt: Confirm the recipient stem is derived from the sender deposit, not a caller parameter.

cross_function_invariants.title: Partial deposit transfer cannot manipulate stem or grown stalk
cross_function_invariants.expected_property: splitting a deposit keeps the original stem and splits BDV proportionally
cross_function_invariants.risk_if_broken: attacker lowers stem on a split to mint grown stalk
cross_function_invariants.review_prompt: Verify a partial transfer reuses the source stem and never recomputes a lower one.

cross_function_invariants.title: Reward scaling cannot over- or under-claim earned beans
cross_function_invariants.expected_property: (endStem-startStem)*bdv applies the correct 1e6 scale; small deltas are not truncated to zero
cross_function_invariants.risk_if_broken: rewards zeroed for recent deposits or inflated on negative deltas
cross_function_invariants.review_prompt: Confirm the stem-scale (PRECISION/1e6) factor is present and the subtraction cannot underflow.

cross_function_invariants.title: User deposit totals match global deposit totals
cross_function_invariants.expected_property: sum of per-account deposited amount/bdv == global totalDeposited/depositedBdv
cross_function_invariants.risk_if_broken: global accounting diverges from user balances
cross_function_invariants.review_prompt: Pair every per-account deposit mutation with its global increment/decrement.

cross_function_invariants.title: roots/stalk ratio stays consistent after reward distribution
cross_function_invariants.expected_property: roots/stalk ratio is preserved across mint and reward steps so earned-bean share is fair
cross_function_invariants.review_prompt: Check roots minting matches stalk minting at the current ratio.

cross_function_invariants.title: Grown stalk is not double-counted after transfer or migration
cross_function_invariants.expected_property: grown stalk accrued before a transfer is moved, not duplicated, to the recipient
cross_function_invariants.risk_if_broken: double-counted grown stalk inflates total stalk
cross_function_invariants.review_prompt: Confirm grown stalk is settled (mowed) before transfer and not re-derived at the recipient.

cross_function_invariants.title: Germinating stalk is converted exactly once
cross_function_invariants.expected_property: germinating stalk becomes active stalk once at germination end; never twice, never skipped
cross_function_invariants.risk_if_broken: stalk totals over/under-stated across the germination boundary
cross_function_invariants.review_prompt: Trace the germination side/season transition for exactly-once conversion.

cross_function_invariants.title: Zero-amount deposits cannot alter accounting
cross_function_invariants.expected_property: an amount==0 deposit/transfer is rejected or a strict no-op
cross_function_invariants.risk_if_broken: empty deposits registered; dust griefing of deposit lists
cross_function_invariants.review_prompt: Confirm an amount==0 path cannot create a deposit record or move stalk.
